reasons.claim: At 5 keV/u, n=2, REAL improves the S1 central ratio from 1.9361 to 1.2022 but remains above its graphical interval. It worsens the S2 HSCC ratio from 1.0028 to 0.6226, losing agreement with its rounding interval. The S1 and S2 extraction intervals are disjoint.

At 5 keV/u, REAL changes n=1 by -25.9% and n=2 by -37.9%. Support sensitivity is material in these cells. A broad claim that support is insignificant across all shells would require a declared metric or weighting; no aggregate was planned.

Common discrepancies persist in narrower cells. At 0.5 keV/u, n=1, B and C are about 0.000216 and 0.000213 of S1 despite only a 1.70% support change. At 0.5 keV/u, n=2 and n=3, and at 5 keV/u, n=3, both remain below the source extraction intervals.
At 5 keV/u, n=1, both B and C lie within the broad S1 extraction interval. Graphical agreement alone does not establish physical validity.
